                                                                     1.



               FADE IN:

1    EXT. LIGHTHOUSE - NIGHT                                          1

     Waves hammer the rocks below. A single lamp turns slowly
     at the top of the tower.

     MARGARET (60s, weathered) climbs the spiral stairs, lantern
     in hand. She stops at a window and stares out to sea.

                             MARGARET
                   Not tonight. Please, not tonight.

     A distant HORN sounds. She freezes.

                             THOMAS (O.S.)
                   Mother? Is that the ship?

                             MARGARET
                       (without turning)
                   Go back to bed, Thomas.

2    INT. LIGHTHOUSE - KEEPER'S ROOM - CONTINUOUS                     2

     Thomas, 12, sits up in a narrow cot. He pulls on his boots
     anyway.

                             THOMAS
                   I can see the lights from here. There
                   are three of them, and they're coming
                   closer every minute. You told me the
                                (MORE)
                                                                     2.
                         CONTINUED:                                  2
                             THOMAS (CONT'D)
                   ships never come this far north.

     He runs to the door.

                                                         CUT TO:

3    EXT. ROCKS - NIGHT                                               3

     The ship's hull splits open on the reef. Men scream.

                                                     FADE OUT.
